summary: BioMar posted its highest-ever Q1 EBITDA in 2024, marking a record financial start to the year. The result demonstrates strong operational and financial performance in the aquaculture feed business during the first quarter period.
title: BioMar off to record start in 2024, posting highest-ever Q1 EBITDA
title_en: BioMar off to record start in 2024, posting highest-ever Q1 EBITDA

summary: BioMar defied expectations of falling revenue by achieving a significant profit increase in the first quarter of 2024. The company's financial performance demonstrates resilience despite broader market challenges in the aquaculture feed sector.
title: BioMar trosset omsetningsfall. Oppnådde resultathopp i første kvartal
title_en: BioMar trosset omsetningsfall. Oppnådde resultathopp i første kvartal

summary: Danny Velez is retiring from his role at BioMar Ecuador, with Andrés Rivadulla assuming the position. The article reports a routine management succession at the regional office in Ecuador without indicating operational or strategic changes to the company's aquaculture feed business in the region.
title: Relevo de liderazgo en BioMar Ecuador: Danny Velez se jubila y asume el cargo Andrés Rivadulla
title_en: Relevo de liderazgo en BioMar Ecuador: Danny Velez se jubila y asume el cargo Andrés Rivadulla

summary: Marine Farm's Capeahuapi center received an award for achieving the best Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR) in the Coho salmon category. The article recognizes operational excellence in aquaculture feed efficiency metrics at this facility.
title: El centro Capeahuapi de Marine Farm obtiene el premio al Mejor FCR en la categoría Coho
title_en: El centro Capeahuapi de Marine Farm obtiene el premio al Mejor FCR en la categoría Coho

summary: BioMar has recognized CES Capeahuapi de Marine Farm as its 2023 Farmers of the Year award recipient. The award highlights exemplary farming practices within BioMar's customer base.
title: Farmers of the Year 2023 BioMar: Reconocen a CES Capeahuapi de Marine Farm
title_en: Farmers of the Year 2023 BioMar: Reconocen a CES Capeahuapi de Marine Farm
